## Checklist

- [ ] Behaviour changes: spec (`docs/architecture/engine-spec.md`) first, then **both** engines, then fixtures
- [ ] New or changed rules come with fixtures, including a case proving functional parameters survive
- [ ] `npm run check`, `cargo test --all` and, for extension changes, `npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] No real tokens, personal links or e-mail addresses in code, fixtures, screenshots or this description
- [ ] No new permissions, network requests or telemetry (or justified and discussed first)
